gap: No result ChatGPT got states the power-bank minimum for the two battery picks: the MoGo 4 needs a third-party bank or adapter of at least 65 W (20 V/3.25 A), and the Capsule 3 needs at least 45 W PD 2.0 at 5–20 V. The Capsule 3's USB-C port only charges and does not carry video.
standout_why: I read iTechGuides (cited, MoGo 4 vs Capsule 3). It says the MoGo 4 'supports USB-C charging using PD 3.0' and that 'not every USB-C bank will supply the required voltage and wattage', but it gives no wattage or voltage for either projector. It calls USB-C video input 'not mentioned' and never mentions AirPlay or iPhone mirroring. RTINGS (cited) and TechRadar (cited) came back as navigation or truncated text with no connectivity claims, so I could not check them. None of the pages I could read gives the maker's power-bank numbers, says the Capsule 3's USB-C is charge-only, or says iPhone AirPlay mirroring of DRM content is blocked.
decides: This confirms the Capsule 3 over the MoGo 4 for a shopper who wants to run the projector from a power bank. The Capsule 3 works from a 45 W PD bank, while the MoGo 4 needs a bank that delivers at least 65 W at 20 V. It also shapes the iPhone advice. On the Capsule 3, Nebula says DRM content cannot be mirrored over AirPlay, and the USB-C port can't take video, so Netflix should come from the built-in licensed app or over HDMI. On the MoGo 4, XGIMI's iOS mirroring route is MagiCast plus Cast Screen on the same Wi-Fi, not native AirPlay. It also rules out Dealectric's Aurzen ZIP for this question, even though Dealectric lists it. ZIP has no Google TV or Netflix app, and Aurzen says Netflix, Hulu and Disney+ cannot be mirrored or cast to it. So it fails the 'Wi-Fi for streaming' need without the separate CastPlay accessory, which Aurzen lists at $129.99.

findings.label: Minimum third-party power bank or adapter
findings.value: Output at least 65 W (65 W at 20 V/3.25 A; 100 W at 20 V/5 A also listed)
findings.source_title: XGIMI Help Center – What are the specific requirements for using an external power bank? (MoGo 4 section)
findings.note: The article gives no PD version and no cable rating.

findings.label: Charging cable and adapter rule (PowerBase Stand accessory listing)
findings.value: Third-party cables must support more than 5 A; third-party adapters must support PD and output more than 65 W
findings.source_title: XGIMI PowerBase Stand for MoGo 4 Series – XGIMI US store
findings.note: From the 'Charging Notes' on the maker's US store listing for the $129 stand, read through storecheck. The stand adds up to 5 h of video when paired with the MoGo 4 series.

findings.label: iPhone/iPad/Mac mirroring method
findings.value: Run the MagiCast app on the projector and use Cast Screen on the iOS device, with both on the same Wi-Fi
findings.source_title: XGIMI Help Center – How to screen-mirror iOS devices to MoGo 4 series?
findings.note: The article states no DRM limits either way.

findings.label: Laptop/PC connection
findings.value: One HDMI port, or Chrome cast over the same Wi-Fi
findings.source_title: XGIMI Help Center – Does MoGo 4 series support screen mirroring with laptops/PCs?
findings.note: USB-C video is not mentioned as an option.

findings.label: Bluetooth output
findings.value: Bluetooth 5.1; pairs external Bluetooth speakers or headphones via All Settings > Remote & Accessories > Pair accessory
findings.source_title: XGIMI Help Center – Does MoGo 4 series support external Bluetooth speakers/headphones?
findings.note: No limits are stated on codecs or on connecting more than one device.

findings.label: US price (maker store)
findings.note: From storecheck search results on us.xgimi.com, which showed it in stock.

findings.label: Minimum power bank
findings.value: Output at least 45 W, PD 2.0, 5–20 V
findings.source_title: Maximizing Projector Battery Life – Nebula/soundcore Support
findings.note: Nebula says this applies to Capsule Air, Capsule 3 and Capsule 3 Laser. Its battery table lists Capsule 3 (D2425) at 2 h in Standard (140 lm) and 2 h 30 min in Eco (100 lm). That the GTV is D2425 comes from retailer listings, not from Nebula.

findings.label: USB-C port role
findings.value: Charging only; HDMI and USB drives use other ports
findings.note: Nebula's answer to 'Can the USB-C port support working with HDMI?': 'the USB-C port can only be used for charging.' The same FAQ recommends a PD charger of at least 45 W when the unit won't charge.

findings.label: iPhone mirroring limit
findings.value: No preloaded AirPlay; AirPlay is enabled through the Nebula Cast app, and DRM-protected content cannot be mirrored or cast over AirPlay; Mac DRM video works only over HDMI
findings.note: The FAQ also says: Chromecast works from Android over Wi-Fi; Netflix comes pre-installed; Bluetooth Speaker Mode is under Settings > Display and Sound > Sound; and the built-in speaker turns off when Bluetooth or AUX speakers or headphones are connected.

findings.label: Streaming-app and DRM limit
findings.value: No Google TV or built-in Netflix; content from Netflix, Hulu, Disney+ and similar services cannot be mirrored or wirelessly cast; Aurzen recommends its CastPlay accessory
findings.source_title: Aurzen ZIP Tri-Fold Portable Projector – Help Center
findings.note: The same page says: mirroring works without Wi-Fi; there is no headphone jack but Bluetooth speakers are supported; fast charging needs a PD adapter of at least 24 W; an OTA fix was issued for iPhone 17 mirroring (17 Air excluded).

findings.label: US price (maker store)
findings.value: $259.99 (US version); CastPlay Pro USB-C wireless dongle $129.99, pre-order, US shipping expected from 2026-11-15
findings.source_title: Aurzen ZIP Tri-Fold Portable Mini Projector | US Version – Aurzen store
findings.note: From storecheck search on aurzen.com. The dongle price is from https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-castplay-pro-usb-c-wireless-dongle in the same search, which claims DRM content (Netflix, Disney+) streams through the dongle.
